note: Scenario seeds are starting points the question writer personalises with the candidate's resume and the JD. They are not a fixed question bank.

scenarios.seed: A SIEM alert shows 40 failed logins across 25 accounts from one IP, followed by one success and an MFA push approval at 02:13 local time.
Twelve alerts arrive within five minutes during a shift: decide what to triage first, what to close and when to escalate to L2/IR.
An endpoint made periodic HTTPS connections every 60 seconds to a newly registered domain; the candidate must say which logs and queries they would use to confirm or dismiss beaconing.
EDR flags vssadmin delete shadows on a file server followed by unusual SMB writes across several shares.
A researcher reports that an S3 bucket containing customer invoices is publicly listable.
A deployment role has AdministratorAccess because 'it was quicker'; design a least-privilege replacement without breaking deployments.
CloudTrail shows an access key for a CI user calling ListBuckets, GetObject and CreateAccessKey from an unfamiliar ASN at 03:00.
A webhook feature fetches any URL the customer supplies and the app runs on a cloud VM with an instance metadata endpoint.
GET /api/invoices/{id} returns other customers' invoices when the id is changed.
A search endpoint builds a SQL ORDER BY clause from a query parameter.
Plan security testing for a new mobile-backend REST API before launch, including authentication and rate limiting.
Flow logs show large outbound DNS TXT queries from a database server to a single external resolver.
A flat office network hosts staff laptops, payment terminals and the build server on one VLAN.
An IDS alerts on SMB connections from a web server in the DMZ to internal hosts.
A long-lived cloud access key is stored as a CI variable shared by every repository, and one was printed in a build log.
The production image scan shows 180 vulnerabilities, 9 critical, most from the base image.
Design the security checks for a pipeline that deploys to production on every merge to main.
Production latency doubled after a release and the dashboards disagree about the cause.
A feature must work offline on mobile and sync later; two teams disagree on the data model.
